blocks.text: Ezekiel 3 brings several parts of Ezekiel’s commission into one sequence: he eats the scroll before speaking, is sent to a resistant people, is moved and strengthened by the Spirit and the Lord’s hand, receives responsibility as a watchman, and is at times restricted in movement and speech. Read together, these scenes present his words and actions as governed by the message he is given rather than by his own freedom to speak whenever he chooses.
